# WDG Videography

> Full-service cinematic video production, product photography and videography, bespoke website design, custom business app development (WDG Software Division) and digital marketing. Based in Cheltenham, Gloucestershire, serving businesses across England.

WDG Videography is a creative production and marketing agency: high-end cinematic video paired with full-scale digital management. Every service below is bookable via https://www.wdgvideography.com

## Services

- Cinematic Video Production: brand films, corporate testimonials, event coverage, drone aerials, YouTube documentaries — packages from £450
- Product Photography: studio-quality product images from £25/image; packages and bundles; ideal for e-commerce, Amazon, Etsy, social media and brand assets
- Product Videography: 15-second social reels from £100, 60-second hero videos from £350, bundles from £499
- Website Design: custom-built, mobile-responsive, SEO-optimised, conversion-focused websites — £1,000–£7,000
- Custom App Development: WDG Software Division — custom business apps from £1,500; farm management platforms, restaurant operations systems, booking and reservation tools, client portals and AI tools; real apps live and in use today — see https://www.wdgvideography.com/app-development
- Social Media Management: end-to-end management of Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and LinkedIn — from £1,200/month
- Brand Strategy: brand positioning, visual identity, tone of voice and competitor analysis
- Full Marketing Management: complete outsourced marketing department — from £1,500/month
